term.label: DNA_loop_anchor

definition.text: The ends of a DNA loop where the two strands of DNA are held in close physical proximity. During interphase the anchors of DNA loops are convergently oriented CTCF binding sites.

comments: Added by Dave to be consistent with other ontologies updated with GREEKC initiative. DS updated defintion Feb 16, 2021. See GitHub Issue #534.
